Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

This dispute is over the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee shown on the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02742), and it turns on whether all four conditions of POL-NS-01 hold. They do. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 18:35:49. (b) The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02742) places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 18:35:49, and it holds 19 qualifying in-radius fixes, so the arrival test of POL-NS-02 is met; the arrival marker's own timestamp coincides with that fix, so POL-NS-05 finds no false marker to correct. (c) The continuous in-geofence dwell runs from that first qualifying fix at 18:35:49 to the cancellation at 18:38:50, i.e. 181 seconds against the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). POL-NS-01(c) expressly measures the dwell from the first qualifying GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' event or the platform wait timer, so the submission that the wait-timer start at 18:35:51 leaves a 179-second shortfall is declined: the wrong clock was used. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 18:38:50 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, at or after the moment the dwell elapsed. The rider's other routes do not open. POL-NS-06 has no shortfall to operate on, because the effective in-geofence dwell (181 s) exceeds the minimum; POL-NS-03 does not apply, because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m radius, not in the 50-400 m wrong-entrance band; POL-NS-04 does not exonerate, because the only chat message is the driver's own, sent 18:36:09, and the rider's 46 fixes sit 622-630 m from the pin, outside the 100 m rider-presence radius. The traffic advisory that POL-NS-06(i) requires before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed is MISSING (EV-ADVIS-02742-01, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, disclosed by both sides), so no outside-radius time can be recovered - which changes nothing here, because the driver's dwell is a single unbroken in-geofence run. The fee therefore stands, and POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of SGD 4.50, which is SGD 3.60. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, below the threshold of 4, so compensation is payable rather than withheld. Under POL-GEN-03 the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd; the rider's charge itself is left as it stands and is not a second payment. Confidence is capped at 1.0, the weight of the GPS trace and trip record that carry the deciding facts. No clause produces a referral: the arrival marker was not false under POL-NS-05(ii), the RIDER_NO_SHOW code was correctly selected, and no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is met (the two-second difference between the wait-timer start and the GPS dwell start is well inside POL-NS-08(a), and POL-NS-01(c) resolves which clock governs). The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this provisional ruling executes automatically, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 3.60 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

(a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 18:35:49. (b) The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02742) places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 18:35:49, and it holds 19 qualifying in-radius fixes, so the arrival test of POL-NS-02 is met; the arrival marker's own timestamp coincides with that fix, so POL-NS-05 finds no false marker to correct. (c) The continuous in-geofence dwell runs from that first qualifying fix at 18:35:49 to the cancellation at 18:38:50, i.e. 181 seconds against the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). POL-NS-01(c) expressly measures the dwell from the first qualifying GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' event or the platform wait timer, so the submission that the wait-timer start at 18:35:51 leaves a 179-second shortfall is declined: the wrong clock was used. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 18:38:50 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, at or after the moment the dwell elapsed. The rider's other routes do not open. POL-NS-06 has no shortfall to operate on, because the effective in-geofence dwell (181 s) exceeds the minimum; POL-NS-03 does not apply, because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m radius, not in the 50-400 m wrong-entrance band; POL-NS-04 does not exonerate, because the only chat message is the driver's own, sent 18:36:09, and the rider's 46 fixes sit 622-630 m from the pin, outside the 100 m rider-presence radius. The traffic advisory that POL-NS-06(i) requires before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed is MISSING (EV-ADVIS-02742-01, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, disclosed by both sides), so no outside-radius time can be recovered - which changes nothing here, because the driver's dwell is a single unbroken in-geofence run. The fee therefore stands, and POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of SGD 4.50, which is SGD 3.60. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, below the threshold of 4, so compensation is payable rather than withheld. Under POL-GEN-03 the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd; the rider's charge itself is left as it stands and is not a second payment. Confidence is capped at 1.0, the weight of the GPS trace and trip record that carry the deciding facts. No clause produces a referral: the arrival marker was not false under POL-NS-05(ii), the RIDER_NO_SHOW code was correctly selected, and no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is met (the two-second difference between the wait-timer start and the GPS dwell start is well inside POL-NS-08(a), and POL-NS-01(c) resolves which clock governs). The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this provisional ruling executes automatically, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.
